svg.title: Compare four builds of the same trivia app
svg.desc: Each tool gets the same Harbor Relay brief. Save its first playable file before asking for a change. Build. Give the shared prompt to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok separately. Test. Check layout, scoring and turns, double taps, the final result and replay. Compare. Record the first five scores. Keep any follow-up edit in a separate record.
